script_text: Stop! Taurus, Venus your ruling planet is blazing through your 1st House of Self, and it's forming a powerful trine to Neptune in your 5th House of Romance. This is NOT a normal Tuesday. In love, someone from your past may resurface or you'll feel an intense magnetic pull toward someone new—Venus in its own sign amplifies your desirability, but don't mistake intensity for compatibility. At work, Mars in your 10th House of Career is squaring your Venus, so assert yourself in negotiations but watch for ego clashes with authority figures—your stubborn nature could cost you a promotion if you refuse to compromise. One financial deal seems too good to be true in your 8th House of Shared Resources—it probably is. Your unexpected gift? A creative insight that could become a profitable side hustle if you act before the Full Moon. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
